item.title: InboxSDK
item.author: emecas
item.description:
InboxSDK
Repo: https://github.com/inboxSDK/inboxsdk
Documentation: https://inboxsdk.github.io/inboxsdk-docs/
Doc repo: https://github.com/InboxSDK/inboxsdk-docs
The InboxSDK lets you build apps for Gmail.

InboxSDK is a JavaScript library for building apps inside Gmail with browser extensions. It features a high-level declarative API that handles all DOM manipulation in a performant way. InboxSDK can handle multiple inboxes, conversation mode, fullscreen compose, popouts, and themes.

Getting Started
https://inboxsdk.github.io/inboxsdk-docs/#quick-start

item.title: TIG: Text-mode interface for git
item.author: emecas
item.description:
TIG
Text-mode interface for git
https://jonas.github.io/tig/
What is Tig?

Tig is an ncurses-based text-mode interface for git. It functions mainly as a Git repository browser, but can also assist in staging changes for commit at chunk level and act as a pager for output from various Git commands.
https://www.flickr.com/photos/jonasfonseca/sets/72157614470764617
